profile: MartialArtist castable nanos (for AOBuddy10 bot decision-making)

dataSource.nanoData: E:\Funcom\OmniCell\OmniCell\Datafiles\nanos.ocp (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3 pack, client 18.8.50_EP1 extraction) loaded via OmniCell.Core NanoLoader.CacheAllNanos

castabilityCriterion: A nano is MA-castable when one of its cast Actions (OmniCell.Enums.ActionType.ToUse=3) carries an Operator.EqualTo requirement on Profession(stat 60)==2 OR VisualProfession(stat 368)==2. All matches use EqualTo. VisualProfession is how most older profession nanos are locked; in this data 43 gate via Profession(60) and 102 via VisualProfession(368).

fieldNotes.minLevel: Character Level requirement read from the ToUse action (stat 54). 0 = no explicit level requirement; the real gate is the nano-skill requirement in castReqs.
fieldNotes.castReqs: The full ToUse action requirement list, stat names from Stat.cs. '>' means the CellAO GreaterThan operator (stat >= value at runtime).
fieldNotes.effectSummary: Derived from the nano's Events->Functions in nanos.ocp. Modify shows 'stat +/-amount'; SummonPet shows the pet template arg; Hit shows [attackType,min,max,...]; other function types shown as Name[rawArgs].
fieldNotes.nanoLine: AOSharp NanoLine enum name for the nano's NanoStrain (stat 75).
